card.name: Disease-severity and qualifier words
card.fires_on: Nouns or qualifiers that follow a modifier describing disease status, such as stage after advanced, risk after high, or suspected after definite or. It also fires on words like occurrence, severity and symptoms in clinical wording.

modes.label: Stage and risk after modifier
modes.description: The word stage or risk comes right after advanced or high in a disease description.
modes.example: Monitor patients with advanced<< stage>> disease and/or high tumor burden and take

modes.label: Qualifier in a paired phrase
modes.description: A qualifying word such as suspected or resembling follows a connector like or or signs.
modes.example: a higher proportion of the clofibrate group experienced definite or<< suspected>> fatal or nonfatal pulmonary embolism

modes.label: Abstract noun about a condition
modes.description: A noun like severity, occurrence or symptoms follows the or first when describing a condition.
modes.example: may be the best indication of the<< severity>> of the overdose.

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted tokens are a mix of unrelated Chinese and code pieces.
card.plain: It marks the word that qualifies a disease, such as the stage, risk level or whether something is suspected.
